newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE sugar ends slightly off on fund selling, N.Y.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE sugar ends slightly off on fund selling, N.Y.

text.p: LIFFE sugar eased in late trading after a dull, rangebound day.
But some of its losses were scrubbed off in the final minutes of trading.
The May contract, which dominated volume, last traded 50 cents lower at $304.20. May volume was 1,259 lots of a total 1,656.
Traders said London was following New York.
"It's long liquidation by funds," one trader said. "The trade, which was supporting it yesterday, is not prepared to buy at the same levels."
But the market remained quiet and lacking in strong direction. "It's just quiet a bit lower," he said.
